mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ai_call_log (service_name, method_name, success, response_time_ms, error_message, input_tokens, output_tokens, model_name, triggered_by, created_time) VALUES
(#{item.serviceName}, #{item.methodName}, #{item.success}, #{item.responseTimeMs}, #{item.errorMessage}, #{item.inputTokens}, #{item.outputTokens}, #{item.modelName}, #{item.triggeredBy}, #{item.createdTime})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_time) AS stat_date, service_name, COUNT(*) AS total_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_calls, CAST(AVG(response_time_ms) AS UNSIGNED) AS avg_response_time_ms, MAX(response_time_ms) AS max_response_time_ms, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS total_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS total_output_tokens FROM ai_call_log WHERE created_time >= #{startTime} AND created_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_time), service_name ORDER BY stat_date, service_name

SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS total_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_calls, CAST(AVG(response_time_ms) AS UNSIGNED) AS avg_response_time_ms, MAX(response_time_ms) AS max_response_time_ms FROM ai_call_log WHERE created_time >= #{todayStart} GROUP BY service_name
